settings.benefit: Let Homey send SMS text messages from a flow

tab1.title: Settings
tab1.instructions: Select a provider and fill in your account data. Send a test SMS to verify if the settings are correct, and save the settings. Now you can start sending text messages from a flow.

freeMobile.hint: Activate 'Notifications par SMS' under Mes options in your Free Mobile account first, or you'll get a 403 error.

clickatell.hint: Use the API Key from an 'Integration' you created in the Clickatell portal, not your account login password.

africasTalking.hint: Use 'sandbox' as Username while testing, or your live app username from the Africa's Talking dashboard once topped up. Only supports sending to African mobile numbers.

httpsms.hint: No provider account needed, but not free either: install the httpSMS Android app on your own phone and pair it at httpsms.com first. 'From' must exactly match that phone's own number - this sends through your phone's own SIM, which bills SMS normally (prepaid credit/plan), not a hosted number. Risk: the app isn't on the Play Store, so this means sideloading an APK - only get it from apk.httpsms.com or their GitHub releases page, and use a spare device, not your primary phone.
